item.title: Zoox Robotaxis Arrive on Uber App in Las Vegas for Riders
item.description: Zoox’s custom‑built robotaxis are now bookable through Uber in Las Vegas, creating the first third‑party ride‑hailing partnership for fully driverless cars and giving riders a new autonomous option.
